title: Test: evaluateTiming is eligible when there's no prior dose
description: A first-ever dose for a profile/medication combination is always eligible -- there's nothing to be too soon after.
acceptance_criteria: @Test fun evaluateTiming_eligible_whenNoMostRecentDose() calls DoseTimingCalculator.evaluateTiming(1_000_000L, null, 60) and asserts the result is DoseTimingResult.Eligible via assertTrue(result is DoseTimingResult.Eligible)
